user.title: FlinQ Orion
user.description: Add the lamp without resetting it. Configure existing mesh keys and an experimental protocol in Options. Without keys the integration remains in observation mode.

init.title: Existing mesh network
init.description: Choose observe for passive diagnostics, query_only for reads, vendor_dp for experimental Tuya DP control or sig for SIG light models. Use existing keys and a dedicated unused unicast controller address (decimal input). Confirm this address has never been used by Smart Life or another controller. Keys are stored locally in HA config entry storage, without additional encryption; protect backups. Import: select the existing entry and submit; keys and metadata are prefilled locally. The original integration is unchanged. Previous controller address: {previous_source}; do not reuse it. A dedicated unused address is still required.

data.connection_mode: Connection mode (on_demand: connect per command, recommended for the battery lamp; persistent: keep a link open)
data.new_source_confirmed: I confirm the controller address is unique and has never previously been used
data.import_entry_id: Import existing mesh credentials from Tuya BLE Mesh (optional)

profile.title: Confirmed light metadata
profile.description: Leave unknown settings disabled. Without confirmed endpoints, colour temperature uses 2000–6500 K, the range Home Assistant's Tuya integration used for this lamp. HSV must use the 12-hex-character format. Scene replay sends only previously received DP6 values.

data.ct_range_confirmed: Linear Kelvin mapping and CT endpoints are confirmed
